source: Wempe's works drawings (References/wempe/drawings/), by drawing number; P0, 14 October 2026: the frame's lines only, provisional until the frame drawings are transcribed (References/wempe/transcriptions/05-08-frame.md). Each line's id is its drawing number without the spaces (050800-1 for 05 08 00-1, as 05 09 01's title block writes its own), since a piece's lines are a space-separated list; 'no' is left empty: bom.py's registry matches a card's numbers against it, and the drawing numbers (05 08 00-1) are not of its form

relations.in: the part's axis inside the named part: tap (thread in a tapped hole), clear (through a clearance hole), run, free, press (as the Hamilton's bom.json)
relations.on: rests against the named part (surfaces within 0.02 mm)

lines.name: Unterplatte (pillar plate)
lines.fn: The lower plate, under the dial: the foundation of the movement.

lines.name: Oberplatte (top plate)
lines.fn: The upper plate, on the train side (its sheet's title block numbers it 05 09 01; the assembly, Oberplatte kompl., is 05 08 01).

lines.name: Pfeiler (pillar)
lines.fn: Hold the plates 19 mm apart, their shoulders in seats in the plates.

lines.name: Pillar screw, dial side (WN standard part, its number not read yet)
lines.fn: Hold each pillar to the pillar plate, from the dial side.

lines.name: Pillar screw, train side (WN standard part, its number not read yet)
lines.fn: Hold the top plate to each pillar, from the train side.
